avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces P-glycoprotein, reducing fexofenadine absorption and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit P-glycoprotein, potentially increasing fexofenadine levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased antihistamine effects; adjust dosing if necessary

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Inhibits P-glycoprotein transporter, significantly increasing fexofenadine bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice; choose alternative beverages

avoid_foods.name: Orange juice (high-volume consumption)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Certain orange juice formulations may inhibit P-glycoprotein and increase fexofenadine absorption
avoid_foods.action: Limit high-volume orange juice consumption; separate dosing by 2+ hours if possible

caution_foods.name: Apple juice
caution_foods.mechanism: May minimally inhibit P-glycoprotein transporter, potentially increasing fexofenadine absorption
caution_foods.action: Moderate consumption acceptable; monitor for excessive antihistamine effects

monitoring_notes: Fexofenadine is primarily a P-glycoprotein substrate with minimal hepatic metabolism, making it less susceptible to CYP450 interactions but vulnerable to P-glycoprotein modulators. Monitor for efficacy loss with P-glycoprotein inducers and increased adverse effects (dizziness, drowsiness) with P-glycoprotein inhibitors.
